ut_indian_creek.name: Indian Creek
ut_indian_creek.note: Spring (Mar-May/June) and fall (Sep-Nov) named by several sources; summer avoided, south-facing walls.

co_clear_creek_canyon.name: Clear Creek Canyon
co_clear_creek_canyon.note: Apr, May, Sep, Oct named best; spring-to-fall season with winter on sunny walls, summer possible early.

co_boulder_canyon.name: Boulder Canyon
co_boulder_canyon.note: Spring (Mar-May prime) and fall shoulder seasons; summer climbable early in shade.

wy_vedauwoo.name: Vedauwoo
wy_vedauwoo.note: CMC and SummitPost both say climbing season is about mid-April through October.

nh_rumney.name: Rumney
nh_rumney.note: HELD by reviewer: months mapped from season words only; "spring" = March is doubtful in New Hampshire. Spring and fall are prime (fall most popular); no month names given, mapped by season words; bugs in spring/early summer.

ky_northern_gorge.name: Northern Gorge
ky_northern_gorge.note: Whole Red River Gorge: early Mar-Apr and Sep-Nov (fall prime, to Thanksgiving); summer hot/humid, winter cold/wet.

bc_the_smoke_bluffs.name: The Smoke Bluffs
bc_the_smoke_bluffs.note: May-Jun shoulder, Jun-Sep driest, Sep-Oct often best; rain Nov-Mar soaks rock.

ut_big_cottonwood_canyon.name: Big Cottonwood Canyon
ut_big_cottonwood_canyon.note: Autumn excellent, spring good (snow lingers early); SLC guide lists Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct; summer workable mornings.

ky_miller_fork_recreational_preserve_mfr.name: Miller Fork Recreational Preserve (MFRP)
ky_miller_fork_recreational_preserve_mfr.note: Shares Red River Gorge system season: early Mar-Apr and Sep-Nov.

ky_pendergrass_murray_recreational_prese.name: Pendergrass-Murray Recreational Preserve (PMRP)
ky_pendergrass_murray_recreational_prese.note: Shares Red River Gorge system season: early Mar-Apr and Sep-Nov.

co_devil_s_head.name: Devil's Head
co_devil_s_head.note: CMC lists Apr-Nov but Rampart Range Rd closed Dec 1-Apr 1; other source says late spring to fall.

ut_little_cottonwood_canyon.name: Little Cottonwood Canyon
ut_little_cottonwood_canyon.note: Fall and spring best (Oct/Nov sweet spot); KAYA Sep-Dec and Mar-Jun, SLC guide Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct; shared window used.
